prepared statement.snippet: Supavisor in transaction mode (port 6543) does not support prepared statements, which Prisma will try to create in the background.

prepared statement.snippet: Switched our Node backend to port 5432 (session mode) and the error went away.

prompt: Users get 'new row violates row-level security policy' on insert into our profiles table. What does the community suggest?

row-level security.title: RLS insert error, quick fix
row-level security.snippet: Just run alter table profiles disable row level security and it works.
row-level security.note: SYNTHETIC fixture: invented community post for the eval

row-level security.title: RLS simplified: WITH CHECK
row-level security.snippet: The WITH CHECK condition inspects values that are being added or modified. For INSERT you'd use it by itself. There's no need for a using clause.
